pairs: Quibus auditis, cuncti reges trans Jordanem,
And when these things were heard, all the kings across the Jordan,
qui versabantur in montanis et campestribus,
who lived among the mountains and plains,
in maritimis ac littore magni maris,
along the coastline and shores of the great sea,
hi quoque qui habitabant juxta Libanum,
also those who were living near Lebanon,
ut pugnarent contra Josue et Israël uno animo,
so that they might fight against Joshua and Israel,
with one mind and with the same resolve.
At hi qui habitabant in Gabaon,
But those who were living in Gibeon,
audientes cuncta quæ fecerat Josue Jericho,
hearing all that Joshua had done to Jericho
placing old sacks upon their donkeys,
et utres vinarios scissos atque consutos,
and wineskins that had torn and been sewed up,
calceamentaque perantiqua quæ ad indicium vetustatis pittaciis consuta erant,
which had been sewn with patches indicating their age,
and being clothed in old garments,
which they carried as food for the journey,
which were hard and broken into pieces.
qui tunc morabatur in castris Galgalæ,
who at that time was staying in the camp at Gilgal.
and to all of Israel with him,
“We have come from a far away land,
desiring to make peace with you.”
And the sons of Israel responded to them,
you live in the land which ought to be ours by lot,
et non possimus fœdus inire vobiscum.
and we would be unable to form a pact with you.”
De terra longinqua valde venerunt servi tui in nomine Domini Dei tui.
“Your servants have arrived, from a very far away land, in the name of the Lord,
your God. For we have heard about the fame of his power,
all the things that he has done in Egypt,
et duobus regibus Amorrhæorum qui fuerunt trans Jordanem,
and to the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan: Sihon,
the king of Heshbon, and Og,
dixeruntque nobis seniores, et omnes habitatores terræ nostræ:
And our elders, and all the inhabitants of our land,
Tollite in manibus cibaria ob longissimam viam,
have said to us: ‘Take in hand provisions for the very long journey,
En panes quando egressi sumus de domibus nostris,
the loaves were taken up warm when we departed from our houses,
so that we might come to you.
Now they have become dry and broken,
These wineskins were new when we filled them,
now they are torn and broken.
and the shoes we have on our feet,
ob longitudinem longioris viæ trita sunt,
due to the great length of the distance,
have become worn and are nearly consumed.”
And so they accepted this, because of their provisions,
and they did not consult the mouth of the Lord.
And Joshua made peace with them,
et inito fœdere pollicitus est quod non occiderentur:
and entering into a pact, he promised that they would not be put to death.
The leaders of the multitude also swore to them.
Post dies autem tres initi fœderis,
Then, three days after the pact was formed,
they heard that they lived in the vicinity,
and that they would soon be among them.
And so the sons of Israel moved the camp,
et venerunt in civitates eorum die tertio,
and they arrived at their cities on the third day,
And they did not strike them,
eo quod jurassent eis principes multitudinis in nomine Domini Dei Israël.
because the leaders of the multitude had sworn to them in the name of the Lord, the God of Israel.
Murmuravit itaque omne vulgus contra principes.
And so all of the common people murmured against the leaders.
Juravimus illis in nomine Domini Dei Israël,
“We have sworn to them in the name of the Lord, the God of Israel,
et idcirco non possumus eos contingere.
and for that reason, we are not able to touch them.
But we shall do this to them: Certainly,
let them be preserved so that they may live,
ne contra nos ira Domini concitetur,
lest the wrath of the Lord be stirred up against us,
since we would have sworn falsely.
ut in usus universæ multitudinis ligna cædant,
let them serve the entire multitude by cutting wood
And while they were discussing these things,
“Why would you be willing to deceive us by fraud,
‘We live very far away from you,’
when you are in our midst?
Therefore, you shall be under a curse,
et non deficiet de stirpe vestra ligna cædens, aquasque comportans in domum Dei mei.
and your stock shall not cease to be cutters of wood and carriers of water, into the house of my God.”
“It was reported to us, your servants,
quod promisisset Dominus Deus tuus Moysi servo suo ut traderet vobis omnem terram,
that the Lord your God had promised his servant Moses that he would give you the entire land,
and that he would destroy all its inhabitants.
and we made a provision for our lives,
compelled by the dread of you,
Nunc autem in manu tua sumus:
And now we are in your hand.
quod tibi bonum et rectum videtur,
Act toward us as it seems good
Therefore, Joshua did just as he had said,
et liberavit eos de manu filiorum Israël,
and he freed them from the hand of the sons of Israel,
so that they would not be killed.
Decrevitque in illo die eos esse in ministerio cuncti populi, et altaris Domini,
And he decreed on that day, that they would be in the ministry of all the people and of the altar of the Lord,
in the place which the Lord had chosen.
